text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking along the academy's 
track—

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Backing down now would bring shame to any 
true child of Edo! How about a little 
contest, then?!"

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Understood. On the pride of the Kongo 
Yaegaki style, I shall gladly accept.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah... haha. At it again, Inari-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Inari-san's challenge fights are basically 
a school tradition, after all! Look, look, 
a crowd's already gathering!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you don't need to worry. It's not that 
kind of serious thing.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"Inari-san has showdowns like that with 
all kinds of people! I've challenged her 
before too!"

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Same here. I thought they were just 
greeting me, but then they suddenly 
challenged me—

text_block_list.name: Watching Students
text_block_list.text:
Whoaaa! Both Inari-senpai and City-senpai 
finished all their bench presses!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Phew... How about we just call it a draw 
right about here?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
What're you being so distant for?! Now 
that we're finally warmed up, let's have a 
deadlift showdown next!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Bring it on. If that's how it's gonna 
be, I'll show you what I'm made of!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"Hey, hey! That's a mighty fine dog paddle 
you've got going, Chiyono O! Truly 
top-tier!"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Huh? R-Really? Was it really that good? 
Ehehe...

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, watchin' you got me all fired up! 
How about it, wanna go head-to-head with 
the great Inari in a doggy paddle 
showdown?! If you lose, I'll treat you to 
a meal!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
“Even a cat will catch a mouse if it walks 
around enough”...! Since you've challenged 
me, I accept with everything I've got!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...And just like that, she goes up to all 
sorts of people, going 'Let's race, let's 
race!' or something like that."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
No, you're exaggerating. ...Well, just 
watch for a second.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Alright then, how about we settle things 
over 2,000 meters today!?

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Bring it on! Now then... let's clash!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And the two of them dashed off all at 
once!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
—Man, that was mighty impressive! You've 
really got the goods, Yaeno!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, the pleasure was mine. A match where 
one couldn't let their guard down for even 
a single second... Truly, it was a great 
learning experience.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And also... thank you very much. Osu!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Oh, what's up with you? Getting all formal 
all of a sudden.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"...I have been struggling to make 
progress lately. Feeling stuck in my 
training, even when standing on the track, 
my anxieties only continue to mount..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"You called out to me at just the right 
time, and gave me such a fiery match. It 
truly reminded me of just how wonderful 
running is!"

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Heh, cut it out. I only called out to you 
because I wanted a race, that's all!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
"...Inari-san reached out to me during a 
time like that, too. When I wasn't doing 
well and was secretly struggling."

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's just like Inari-senpai. Her 
methods... and her thoughtfulness.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey hey, what's the deal?! Were you 
gossiping about me? My nose has been 
tickling non-stop!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
"How's about moving your legs instead of 
your mouth? Let's have a match with the 
great Inari-sama!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Perhaps this refreshing cheerfulness 
is what supports those around her. Hearing 
her voice, Gold City and the others 
smiled."

text_block_list.text:
You got it! Let's do this, City, Chiyono

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Here I gooooo... Hup, yahhh!!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Whoaaaaaa...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the three of them put on a 
thrilling, all-out brawl that was truly 
satisfying to watch!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, then let's all run together! You, 
City, Chiyono O, all of us!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
In fact, I'm not gonna be petty right now! 
Anyone who wants a fight, line up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's the wildest brawl festival in Tracen 
Academy history! Here we goooo~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...And so, the academy's track descended 
into absolute festive chaos."
